Package org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.variable.impl.type

Class FileValueTypeImpl

java.lang.Object
org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.variable.impl.type.AbstractValueTypeImpl
org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.variable.impl.type.FileValueTypeImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, FileValueType, ValueType
public class FileValueTypeImpl extends AbstractValueTypeImpl implements FileValueType
Valuetype to save files from byte arrays, inputstreams or just files as process variables and retrieve them via an InputStream.
Since:
7.4

Ronny Bräunlich
